report: Read all 16 candidate groups and the full dump end to end; none is a split. Every multi-treatment bucket is the ASV rendering one word differently (waw → and/also/but/for/nor, לְ → For/unto/to/on/of, זֶה → one/another, קֶרֶן with a supplied the under rule 15 in v4, a suffix in v5, and a construct the under rule 29 in v10).

אַל: v4 writes an אַל per colon and each takes its own not; v5 writes one אַל over two asyndetic jussives and the ASV rewrites not, so both belong to the one negative under rule 25. Different Hebrew, consistent analysis.

Connectives checked against the Hebrew in every verse: the added But of v10 and the added and of v8 stand in asyndetic cola with no waw; the also of v10 goes to the verse-initial waw under rule 51; v6 gives neither to the present לֹא and nor to the waw (rule 14), and fuses the second וְלֹא as Nor yet under rule 35 with the competing split named in the note.

Supplied subjects are consistent: v1 Men and v6 cometh are added (rules 17, 20); v7 He goes with the finite verb (rule 17, as rule 25 directs when a finite verb stands in the resumed clause); v8 It is full resumes the written יַיִן in a verbless clause (rule 25). Supplied object them ×2 in v8 added under rule 44.
BSB: 109/109 comparable tokens agree; nothing to adjudicate.

The four repeating notes (construct takes supplied the, rectum takes of, supplied a/the joins the noun) restate rules 29, 19 and 15 and need no convention. Nothing here generalises beyond the contract; no promotions or amendments.
